name: jvmind-mat
description: Analyze Java heap dumps locally with Eclipse MAT: histograms, dominators, threads, OQL, leak suspects, and OOM diagnosis.
long_description:
JVMind MAT runs Eclipse MAT on your machine and exposes its analysis as MCP tools. Open a .hprof file, wait for indexing, then inspect the heap overview, class histogram, dominator tree, thread stacks, ThreadLocals, individual objects, GC paths, OQL results, LeakHunter suspects, OOM diagnosis, connection pools, top consumers, and SQL in threads.

Requirements: JDK 21 and Eclipse MAT 1.17.x. The server installs a small query bundle into MAT on first use. Heap dumps stay on the local machine; the helper service binds to 127.0.0.1 only.

mat_home.title: Eclipse MAT home
mat_home.description: Directory containing plugins/ and configuration/ for Eclipse MAT 1.17.x. Leave empty to auto-detect.

mat_xmx.title: MAT heap size
mat_xmx.description: JVM heap for MAT parsing and queries, for example 8g. Defaults to 70% of physical RAM, minimum 4g.

tools.name: open_heapdump
tools.description: Open a local .hprof file and start background MAT indexing. Returns a report_id immediately.

tools.name: get_heapdump_status
tools.description: Poll parsing status and progress for a heap dump report.

tools.name: list_heapdumps
tools.description: List heap dumps known to this MCP server and their status.

tools.name: close_heapdump
tools.description: Release a heap dump handle, optionally stopping the MAT helper process.

tools.name: mat_overview
tools.description: Heap overview: used/committed/live heap, object/class/classloader counts, JDK version, leak suspect count.

tools.name: mat_histogram
tools.description: Class histogram sorted by shallow, retained, or object count.

tools.name: mat_dominator
tools.description: Dominator tree of the largest retained-heap objects, with drill-down by parent object id.

tools.name: mat_threads
tools.description: List threads or drill into a thread's stack frames and frame locals.

tools.name: mat_threadlocals
tools.description: Inspect ThreadLocal values grouped by value class or thread.

tools.name: mat_object
tools.description: Inspect a single object: class, fields, references, and GC root.

tools.name: mat_path2gc
tools.description: Shortest path from an object to a GC root.

tools.name: mat_oql
tools.description: Run an OQL query and return rows plus a reusable result set id.

tools.name: mat_leak_suspects
tools.description: Run LeakHunter and return leak suspects with retained sizes and descriptions.

tools.name: mat_diagnose_oom
tools.description: Composite OOM diagnosis combining leak suspects, SQL in threads, and dominator analysis.

tools.name: mat_connection_pools
tools.description: Diagnose database connection pools and connections held longer than a threshold.

tools.name: mat_top_consumers
tools.description: Top memory consumers by retained heap.

tools.name: mat_sql_in_threads
tools.description: Find SQL statements in thread stacks, useful for long-running queries at OOM.
